About the show

A Slice of The Pie is A Play, A Pie and A Pint’s very own scratch night, hosted by our artistic team as part of our work to platform and champion exciting new artists in Scotland. The night consists of ‘slices’ of new work from incredible writers, directors and performers who we have never worked …...

Concessions at A Play, a Pie and a Pint

A Play, a Pie and a Pint tickets include a drink and a pie. Prices rise across the week, from Monday to Saturday, and a cheaper play-only ticket is held back for midweek performances.

Play-only ticket

Tuesday to Thursday, for students, arts workers, and audience members who are unemployed or on a low income or household benefits. The ticket covers the play without the pie and drink.

Chosen when booking.

Fees

Published prices include a £1.50 booking fee. A small extra fee applies when booking online through Universe.
